notes.title: Shadow Lotus has Released on Steam!
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630436/b752d621be4c6c068c745695a42dc3012bae988d.png"][/img][b]Our Latest Mature Open-World RPG, [i]Shadow Lotus[/i], is available on Steam![/b][/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Step into the shadows of Edo-era Japan as a rogue shinobi, cast out from your clan.[/h3][p]Shape your path through this beautiful world, but beware that all your actions have consequences.[/p][p]Side with gorgeous Japanese princesses to earn more than just their support.[/p][p]Master the combat system to defeat everyone who stands in your way.[/p][p]Choose your own destiny and decide the fate of the empire![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Main features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Thrilling combat system with [b]Katanas[/b], [b]Stealth, Parkour, [/b]and the devastating [b]Lotus Techniques[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Seduce a big cast of [b]beautiful Japanese princesses and noblewomen[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Explore an [b]immersive [/b]and [b]gorgeous[/b] world, filled with [b]bamboo forests[/b], [b]misty mountains[/b], and [b]coastal villages[/b], all filled with [b]quests[/b], [b]challenges[/b], and [b]hidden treasures[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Make [b]meaningful choices[/b] that will shape your own path:[b] side with warring clans[/b], or [b]betray them all[/b] in your pursuit of power.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Experience Japan and everything it has to offer in a way you've never experienced before![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3873980/Shadow_Lotus/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Developer Update – *Violated Princess v1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Developer Update – Violated Princess v1.1.0[/b]
[i]MacOS Support + Optimizations + UI Fixes[/i]

Brave warriors,

We're excited to announce that MacOS support has officially been added to [b][i]Violated Princess[/i][/b]! Players on Mac can now fully experience the dark fantasy survival of Aurelia's corrupted kingdom.

This update also includes several performance optimizations to ensure smoother gameplay across all platforms, along with a round of UI bug fixes that were missed in the initial release — including button alignment, resolution scaling, and controller prompts.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Stay strong, and keep surviving.
— The Violated Princess Dev Team 🗡️👑💔
